title: Ask for clarification without blocking work
summary: Viết câu hỏi làm rõ ngắn, lịch sự và có thể hành động trong công việc.
learningObjectives: Xác nhận cách hiểu hiện tại

sections.title: Ambiguous ticket
sections.content: Ticket: Make the export faster and ready for enterprise customers by Friday. No target latency, data size or owner is specified.

exercises.question: Câu nào giúp nhóm ra quyết định nhanh nhất?
options: For the Friday release, should we optimize the 10k-row CSV export to finish under 5 seconds, and is Mai the approver?
correctAnswer: For the Friday release, should we optimize the 10k-row CSV export to finish under 5 seconds, and is Mai the approver?
exercises.explanation: Câu hỏi tốt xác nhận scope, success signal và owner.

performanceTask.title: Send a clarification request
performanceTask.scenario: Bạn cần bắt đầu ticket nhưng acceptance criteria còn mơ hồ.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Viết tin nhắn hỏi lại mà chưa xem mẫu.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Viết tin nhắn gồm cách hiểu hiện tại, hai điểm cần xác nhận và bước bạn sẽ làm sau khi nhận câu trả lời.
performanceTask.modelResponse: My current understanding is that we need the 10k-row CSV export under five seconds for Friday. Could you confirm whether XLSX is in scope and whether Mai approves the benchmark? Once confirmed, I’ll add the performance test and share the result today.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Viết lại, tập trung vào tiêu chí chưa đạt và giữ tin nhắn dưới 100 từ.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Một API ticket nói 'improve reliability'. Hãy hỏi làm rõ success metric, phạm vi và owner.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Viết câu hỏi làm rõ cho một yêu cầu mới mà không xem lại model.

baseline.title: Enterprise export request
baseline.brief: Bạn chuẩn bị sprint planning. Xác nhận cách hiểu hiện tại, hỏi các tiêu chí còn thiếu và nêu bước sẽ làm sau khi product trả lời.

artifacts.title: Ticket EXP-214
artifacts.content: Make the customer export faster and enterprise-ready by Friday. Current CSV exports contain up to 10,000 rows. The ticket does not specify a target duration, whether XLSX is in scope or who approves the benchmark.

artifacts.title: Planning thread
artifacts.content:
Product: Enterprise customers mentioned exports in two calls.
Engineering: We can add a benchmark once the expected format and latency are confirmed.
Delivery lead: Friday is the requested date, but no approver is named.

retry.title: Partner webhook request
retry.brief: Sửa tin nhắn clarification cho partner demo: giữ giọng lịch sự, biến từ 'flaky' thành câu hỏi đo được và chốt next action.

artifacts.title: Ticket WEB-88
artifacts.content: Fix flaky webhook delivery before Tuesday's partner demo. The dashboard shows retries, but the request has no acceptable success rate, event types in scope or decision owner. The demo environment currently uses the standard retry policy.

artifacts.title: Team note
artifacts.content: Known deadline: Tuesday demo. Known environment: partner demo. Missing: reliability threshold, event scope, approver. Engineering can run a replay test after those points are confirmed.

transfer.title: API reliability request
transfer.brief: Unseen transfer: hỏi làm rõ success metric, phạm vi endpoint và owner mà không dùng lại dữ kiện export hoặc webhook.

artifacts.title: Ticket API-431
artifacts.content: Improve API reliability for the mobile launch next week. Recent alerts cover both authentication and profile endpoints, but the ticket does not define an error-rate target, launch-critical endpoints or the person who accepts the result.

artifacts.title: Launch channel
artifacts.content:
Mobile lead: We need a go/no-go signal by Thursday.
API team: We can compare the last seven days once the endpoint scope and acceptable failure rate are agreed.
Release coordinator: Acceptance owner is still open.

review.title: Audit-log retention request
review.brief: Delayed review: viết câu hỏi làm rõ mới từ memory của workflow, không xem lại model hay các response trước.

artifacts.title: Compliance request
artifacts.content: Make audit-log retention ready for regulated customers next sprint. Current retention is 30 days in the primary region. The request does not name the required retention period, whether replicas are included or who signs off on compliance.

artifacts.title: Security handoff
artifacts.content: Target window: next sprint. Current state: 30-day primary-region retention. Missing decisions: duration, regional scope, compliance approver. Platform can estimate storage cost after scope confirmation.

rubric.label: Current understanding
rubric.description: States a concrete interpretation instead of only saying it is unclear.

rubric.label: Specific questions
rubric.description: Asks for measurable scope, success signal or ownership.

rubric.label: Next action
rubric.description: Explains what will happen after clarification.
